description: Pass branch context to Chat Tree item chats and keep reserved branches safe.

hooks.command: python3 -c "import os,runpy,sys; p=sys.argv[1]; os.path.isfile(p) or sys.exit(0); os.environ['CHAT_TREE_HOST']='claude'; sys.argv=[p]; runpy.run_path(p,run_name='__main__')" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/plugins/chat-tree/hooks/guard.py"
